sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Waheed Choudhary, Advocate
 vs
Ut of J&K & Anr. ..... Respondent(s)
 Through: Mr. Bhanu Jasrotia, Ga
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Parihar, Judge
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has gone through the status report filed by the Investigating Agency, who has found that the case is not made out against the petitioner, which reinforces the claim of the petitioner that case lodged by the respondent/complainant was false and fictitious.
He further submits that continuation of further proceeding would be an abuse of process because once the closure report is filed, the complainant may further drag the petitioner to the proceedings.
He, therefore, submits that his petition be allowed by quashing the entire proceedings.

Which is contested by the other side on the plea that though offence under Sections 342/109/343/354 IPC have been found not made out and the Investigation has been closed as not admitted, so closure report is required to be placed before the Competent Court and that quashing the entire proceedings would not suffice the cause of the justice.

2. Having given thoughtful consideration to the submissions made at Bar, the petitioner had questioned contours of FIR No. 129 of 2023 under Section 376, 382 IPC which was registered by Police Station Rajouri, whereas, during the course of investigation it has been found that the complainant and the accused got married, thereafter some issues surfaced inter se them because of such, they got separated.
So much so the complainant as well as petitioner have settled their issues.

It is further found that because of a matrimonial dispute, the complainant in anger had lodged the FIR and during investigation she has come up with the plea that she does not want to continue the investigation in this FIR.
3. The complainant has been arrayed as respondent No. 2 here in this petition whereas in terms of office report notice issued to her on 31.05.2023, but despite service she has not appeared.
In order to take this petition to a logical conclusion, let a fresh notice be served to her through SHO Police Station Rajouri enabling her to cause appearance in this case.
